text: Because the token supply is controlled by ICO promoters who must reserve tokens for future funding needs, token holders can be diluted by later issuance of reserve tokens and their token value can be diminished without any ability to protect themselves against such events.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, Marco Dell'Erba, Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags (2017). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3067615

isBasedOn.name: Initial Coin Offerings Emerging Practices, Risk Factors, and Red Flags

abstract: Because the token supply is controlled by the ICO promoters, the token holders may be diluted in the future if the platform decides to issue more reserve tokens to additional investors.

additionalProperty.name: scope_conditions
value: platforms that reserve tokens for future funding needs
